item.title: New York Measles Death Highlights Vaccine Crisis in US
item.description: First measles death in New York in 30+ years underscores a national surge, with seven U.S. fatalities this year amid declining vaccination rates.

item.title: Hospitals Revamp Measles Protocols Amid 2026 Surge
item.description: U.S. hospitals deploy revamped screening, isolation and telehealth workflows to combat a record measles outbreak, protecting vulnerable patients.
